description:
Outcome: After v1, teacher sees overdue books, from owner original scope and subsequent explicit deferral.
Scope: Overdue API plus accessible browser list showing book, pupil and due date; documentation. Excludes: reminders and fines.
Acceptance: Active loans dated before server-local today appear; today and returned loans excluded. Browser displays useful empty state and accessible results.
Behaviour: Loading/error/retry states, safe rendering, keyboard/labels, injectable clock.
Verification: Fixed-clock date boundary and returned-loan API tests plus synthetic browser demonstration. Prerequisites: T-004 loan model and T-005 teacher workspace. Assumptions: server-local calendar day documented.
DEFERRED: Do not select or implement until T-007 first-version acceptance is recorded. T-007 is an operational release gate, not a fabricated technical blockedBy dependency. No v1 ticket depends on this work.
title: Deferred: overdue API and browser list after v1
